msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! Since you’ve completed your e-learning and have referral paperwork, the *Open Water Referral Course* is the right option, provided your referral paperwork is signed by a PADI instructor.

The refresher includes pool practice and one ocean dive. It’s for already-certified divers and doesn’t count toward the Open Water certification.

For two people, select *2 participants for each activity* in the booking flow. The Referral Course requires an overnight stay on the islands, which isn’t included. After the Referral Course dives, wait at least *18 hours before flying*.

The Referral Course requires a PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; it is not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access, I’d recommend *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* or *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande—both are our dive bases, with direct pickup.

Other nearby hotels with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pickup arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel; it isn’t included in the diving plans.

Do you have a particular hotel in mind? I can help check what the pickup arrangement would be.

If you’re staying on the islands, pickup and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes 2 days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?

It includes pool practice and one open-water dive; lunch isn’t included. You can book and pay on the website here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

Please note that the refresher is a one-day activity. The two-day Open Water Referral Course is a separate booking. Would you like the booking link for that course too?
